title: Project claim
description: A typed statement in a project's truth layer. The kind determines binding force and who may change it. See docs/KNOWLEDGE_TAXONOMY.md.

created_by.description: billy | orchestrator | role id. project_requirement and hard_constraint require billy (or OOS security policy for global constraints).

evidence.description: IDs: EVD-, DEC-, ADR-, CTX- (CTX only as evidence).

review_trigger.description: For assumptions/hypotheses: what observation would invalidate or confirm it.

enforced_by.description: Gate or policy-guard rule IDs that enforce this claim (hard constraints especially).
